test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The speed of a boat in still water is 7 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 5 km/hr. A man rows to a place at a distance of 52.8 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time (in hours) taken by him.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream Speed** = 7 + 5 = 12 km/hr

**Upstream Speed** = 7 − 5 = 2 km/hr

**Total Time** = (Distance ÷ Downstream Speed) + (Distance ÷ Upstream Speed)

**Total Time** = (52.8 ÷ 12) + (52.8 ÷ 2) = 4.4 + 26.4 = 30.8 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 30.8 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5883fe75e5b324991a239bfca78cd7a9bd29090f40e48dd85a4da6fde466e919.png] 

**Given:**

Speed of boat in still water (u) = 7 km/hr

Speed of stream (v) = 5 km/hr

One-way distance (D) = 52.8 km

**Formula Used:**

Downstream Speed (Sd) = u + v

Upstream Speed (Sᵤ) = u − v

Total Time = Tdₒwₙ + Tᵤₚ

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sd = 7 + 5 = 12 km/hr

⇒ Sᵤ = 7 − 5 = 2 km/hr

⇒ Time taken downstream = 52.8 ÷ 12 = 4.4 hours

⇒ Time taken upstream = 52.8 ÷ 2 = 26.4 hours

⇒ Total time = 4.4 + 26.4 = 30.8 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 30.8 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed of Boat

The average speed for a round trip is calculated as (Sd × Sᵤ) / u, where u is speed in still water.

Finding u and v from speeds

Speed in still water (u) = (Sd + Sᵤ) ÷ 2 and Speed of stream (v) = (Sd − Sᵤ) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed Concept

In downstream, the stream helps the boat (addition), while in upstream, the stream opposes the boat (subtraction).</p
